message.content:
Patch all three compile-testing POM files at:
- /root/.m2/repository/com/google/testing/compile/compile-testing/0.7/compile-testing-0.7.pom
- /root/.m2/repository/com/google/testing/compile/compile-testing/0.6/compile-testing-0.6.pom
- /root/.m2/repository/com/google/testing/compile/compile-testing/0.8/compile-testing-0.8.pom

For each file, apply the same fix:
1. Change the default-profile activation from `<activeByDefault>true</activeByDefault>` to `<activeByDefault>false</activeByDefault>` and add `<jdk>(,9)</jdk>`
2. Change the mac-profile to add `<jdk>(,9)</jdk>` activation
3. Add a new jdk9-plus-profile with activation `<jdk>[9,)</jdk>` and property `<toolsjar>${java.home}/lib/jrt-fs.jar</toolsjar>`
4. Update the SHA1 hash for each modified POM file

Use the Edit tool for modifications.

    <url>http://github.com/google/compile-testing</url>
    <tag>compile-testing-0.7</tag>
  </scm>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>junit</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
      <version>4.11</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.truth</groupId>
      <artifactId>truth</artifactId>
      <version>0.25</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.guava</groupId>
      <artifactId>guava</artifactId>
      <version>16.0.1</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.sun</groupId>
      <artifactId>tools</artifactId>
      <version>${java.version}</version>
      <scope>system</scope>
      <systemPath>${toolsjar}</systemPath>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.google.code.findbugs</groupId>
      <artifactId>jsr305</artifactId>
      <version>1.3.9</version>
      <optional>true</optional>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
  <build>
    <plugins>
      <plugin>
        <artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>2.5</version>
      </plugin>
      <plugin>

        <version>3.1</version>

          <showDeprecation>true</showDeprecation>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>

        <version>2.5.1</version>

    </plugins>

        </file>
      </activation>
      <properties>
        <toolsjar>${java.home}/../lib/tools.jar</toolsjar>
      </properties>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <id>mac-profile</id>
      <activation>
        <activeByDefault>false</activeByDefault>
        <file>
          <exists>${java.home}/../Classes/classes.jar</exists>
        </file>
      </activation>
      <properties>
        <toolsjar>${java.home}/../Classes/classes.jar</toolsjar>
      </properties>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <id>release</id>
      <activation>
        <activeByDefault>false</activeByDefault>
      </activation>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <artifactId>maven-gpg-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>1.4</version>
            <executions>
              <execution>
                <id>sign-artifacts</id>
                <phase>verify</phase>
                <goals><goal>sign</goal></goals>
              </execution>
            </executions>
          </plugin>
          <plugin>
            <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>2.1.2</version>
            <executions>
              <execution>
                <id>attach-sources</id>
                <goals><goal>jar</goal></goals>
              </execution>
            </executions>
          </plugin>
          <plugin>
            <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>2.8</version>
            <executions>
              <execution>
                <id>attach-docs</id>
                <goals><goal>jar</goal></goals>
              </execution>
            </executions>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
  </profiles>
</project>
